DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The blood culture showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility is pathognomonic for *Listeria*. Given your pregnancy and recent consumption of unpasteurized dairy, I have established the diagnosis without further testing. Please ensure immediate hospitalization for IV antibiotics and fetal monitoring.
